meta.niche: Vacation rental and short-term rental property management software (channel manager, PMS, direct booking)

analysis.summary: Hostaway is the only company with real publishing activity in the last 30 days. Hospitable, OwnerRez and Uplisting published nothing, and Lodgify published one event page.

points.text: Hostaway published 2 new pages and updated 4 older ones, mostly how-to and news that react to Airbnb and Booking.com changes.
Lodgify's only new page promotes a free livestream, the Independent Host Summit 2026, which points to event-led reach with independent hosts.
Hospitable, OwnerRez and Uplisting showed no new or updated pages, so nobody is contesting fast-reaction content right now.

Hostaway.play: Fast news on platform changes, plus refreshed guides and an AI benchmark report.

Hospitable.play: No new or updated pages this month. No visible play.

OwnerRez.play: No recent publishing. Its 7793 pages are mostly forums, support and reviews.

Lodgify.play: Promotes a free livestream event, the Independent Host Summit 2026.

Uplisting.play: No new or updated pages this month. No visible play.

shared.title: Quiet month
shared.text: Hospitable, OwnerRez and Uplisting published nothing new and updated nothing. Hostaway can set the pace on timely topics without much pressure from them.

shared.title: Big pages, little activity
shared.text: OwnerRez has 7793 pages and Hospitable has 861, but neither showed any change in 30 days. Hostaway's recent output is small, but it is the only steady one.

gaps.title: Live events for hosts
gaps.text: Only Lodgify ran an event page, and it is one page. Hostaway could host a free summit or webinar series for property managers.

gaps.title: Platform change alerts
gaps.text: Nobody but Hostaway covered Booking.com or Airbnb changes. Hostaway could build a standing hub that tracks every channel update.

gaps.title: Comparison pages vs rivals
gaps.text: No competitor showed comparison content, and Hostaway has only 1 page on it. Hostaway could own PMS and channel manager comparison searches.
